title: Business Ethics
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office hosts a business ethics seminar led by Holly, during which various ethical issues and personal confessions are discussed. The episode explores workplace relationships, misconduct, and the challenges of maintaining ethical standards in a corporate environment, with characters navigating suspicion, tension, and humor related to ethical dilemmas.
